status: analysis exploration lock; not a model; no version assigned

contextualStrategySelector.model: one LightGBM Huber regression per bet type with strategy id as an input
contextualStrategySelector.trainingRows: every prior race x every fixed strategy; full-information counterfactual target becomes available only after the race date ends
contextualStrategySelector.target: equal-weight realized return rate of the strategy's top 10 distinct 100-yen tickets

raceSelection.selector: expanding LightGBM Huber course-return regression using prior dates only
raceSelection.coldStart: average contextual-strategy predicted return and top-ticket score across required bet types

allocation: after mandatory 100 yen per required bet type, allocate remaining 100-yen units by chosen-strategy ticket score multiplied by max(0.1, contextual predicted return), respecting the 10% per-ticket cap
